title: Fixed Twin Loop Backframe and Long Nozzle Blower
description: One newly authored complete fixed backframe leaf-blower-style exterior, standing empty on its own broad lower skid. A tall integral backplate and two thick closed shoulder loops carry a low rounded reservoir exterior, a stepped transverse round fan-case exterior and one compact motor-shaped cap, with a complete raised carry arch. A continuous thick bent flexible-hose exterior leaves a lateral neck and sweeps forward into a separate long rigid nozzle with a genuine deep blind mouth and fixed control grip. It is not the old tall filter/bag collector put on a backpack: no collection vessel or filter tower remains, and the supporting backplate, two empty shoulder openings, lateral bend and long forward tube are authored as a whole compact pack. No old meshes imported. One complete model zero scenes, three opaque solid PBR roles. Static illustrative exterior only; no fan rotor, internal air circuit, fuel contents, airflow, blowing/cleaning, wearable fit, weight, vibration, emissions, operation or machinery safety ability. The terminal mouth is blind and does not imply a through hose. Rigging animation interaction not made.
